eyebrow.zh: 识别文本中的中国标识符、手机号和内网域名模式，按规则掩码或阻断，并可记录审计。
eyebrow.en: Detect Chinese identifier, phone and internal-domain patterns in text, apply masking or blocking rules, and optionally record an audit.

headline.zh:
先检查待发文本，
再决定掩码或阻断
headline.en:
Inspect outgoing text.
Choose masking or blocking.

sub.zh: 识别文本中的中国标识符、手机号和内网域名模式，按规则掩码或阻断，并可记录审计。
sub.en: Detect Chinese identifier, phone and internal-domain patterns in text, apply masking or blocking rules, and optionally record an audit.

caption.zh: 字段识别 · 掩码策略

body.zh: scan 输出行列、类型与适用校验状态。
body.en: scan emits line, column, type and applicable checksum status.

body.zh: 按规则选择掩码或不输出。
body.en: Choose masking or no output according to policy.

body.zh: 可选审计保存处理后的预览与元数据。
body.en: Optional audit retains masked previews and metadata.

title.zh: 把需要处理的字段单独找出来
title.en: Isolate the fields that need handling

body.zh: 代码和说明文字里可能混有不应直接发送的字段。RedactGate 在显式接入的文本或网关路径上识别支持的模式，返回命中位置，并根据规则替换或阻断。规则检测范围有限，不是数据不外流或合规状态的全面保证。
body.en: Code and prose can contain fields that should not be sent unchanged. RedactGate detects supported patterns on explicitly routed text or gateway paths, returns hit locations, and masks or blocks by policy. Its rules do not guarantee complete data-loss prevention or compliance.

body.zh: 实际运行 scan、label 掩码和 block 过滤器；最后一步没有 stdout。没有启动代理、发送模型请求或验证法律合规。
body.en: The real scan, label masker and block filter run locally; the final step emits no stdout. No proxy, model request or legal-compliance verification is performed.

alt.zh: 实际运行 scan、label 掩码和 block 过滤器；最后一步没有 stdout。没有启动代理、发送模型请求或验证法律合规。
alt.en: The real scan, label masker and block filter run locally; the final step emits no stdout. No proxy, model request or legal-compliance verification is performed.

body.zh: detectors 识别候选并执行适用校验，rules 合并内置与用户配置，redactor 处理命中区间，mask/proxy 消费结果并执行 block。audit 保存掩码预览与事件元数据。JSON 请求体路径会处理字符串值，响应转发支持流式读取。
body.en: Detectors recognize candidates and apply relevant checks, rules merges defaults with overrides, and redactor rewrites matched spans. mask/proxy consumes the result and enforces block. Audit records masked previews and event metadata. The JSON-body path handles string values, and response forwarding supports streaming.

alt.zh: detectors 识别候选并执行适用校验，rules 合并内置与用户配置，redactor 处理命中区间，mask/proxy 消费结果并执行 block。audit 保存掩码预览与事件元数据。JSON 请求体路径会处理字符串值，响应转发支持流式读取。
alt.en: Detectors recognize candidates and apply relevant checks, rules merges defaults with overrides, and redactor rewrites matched spans. mask/proxy consumes the result and enforces block. Audit records masked previews and event metadata. The JSON-body path handles string values, and response forwarding supports streaming.

body.zh: 只处理经过本工具的输入；未路由流量、未支持格式、漏报模式不会自动受保护。网关接入与模型协议兼容性需要单独验证，不能仅凭 stdin 结果宣称全链路保护。
body.en: Only routed input is processed. Unrouted traffic, unsupported formats and missed patterns are not automatically protected. Gateway integration and model-protocol compatibility require separate validation beyond stdin results.

alt.zh: 只处理经过本工具的输入；未路由流量、未支持格式、漏报模式不会自动受保护。网关接入与模型协议兼容性需要单独验证，不能仅凭 stdin 结果宣称全链路保护。
alt.en: Only routed input is processed. Unrouted traffic, unsupported formats and missed patterns are not automatically protected. Gateway integration and model-protocol compatibility require separate validation beyond stdin results.

body.zh: 需要显式客户端 base URL 接入；不透明拦截系统全部 HTTPS。
body.en: Explicit client base-URL routing is required; system-wide HTTPS is not transparently intercepted.

note.zh: 实际运行 scan、label 掩码和 block 过滤器；最后一步没有 stdout。没有启动代理、发送模型请求或验证法律合规。
note.en: The real scan, label masker and block filter run locally; the final step emits no stdout. No proxy, model request or legal-compliance verification is performed.

body.zh: scan 返回命中位置，退出 1 表示发现字段。
body.en: scan returns hit locations; exit 1 indicates detected fields.

body.zh: 仅对识别区间应用 label 样式。
body.en: Apply label style to recognized spans.

steps.output:
Synthetic fixture
id=[身份证-已脱敏]
phone=[手机号-已脱敏]
intranet=[内网域名-已脱敏]
order=110101199003078500

body.zh: block 策略命中后退出 1，stdout 为空。
body.en: A block-policy hit exits 1 with empty stdout.

body.zh: 需要 Python 3.12+。示例使用刻意构造的测试文本，scan 与 block 命中时退出 1 是预期行为。
body.en: Requires Python 3.12+. The demo uses deliberately synthetic text. Exit 1 from scan or block is expected when a hit is present.

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/redactgate.git
cd redactgate
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -e .

python -m redactgate.cli scan examples/presentation-input.txt --json
python -m redactgate.cli mask --style label < examples/presentation-input.txt
python -m redactgate.cli mask --rules examples/presentation-block.yaml < examples/presentation-input.txt

limitations.zh: 支持的模式与校验有限，不能保证发现全部敏感数据。
limitations.en: Supported patterns and checks are limited and cannot guarantee detection of all sensitive data.

limitations.zh: 规则 confidence 是静态分值，不是已校准概率。
limitations.en: Rule confidence is a fixed score, not a calibrated probability.

limitations.zh: 本地检测不等于法律合规或全链路防泄漏证明。
limitations.en: Local detection is not legal-compliance or end-to-end data-loss-prevention proof.
